## watcher_vcs_exclude

- renamed to `watcher_exclude_vcs_path`
- description: `"Exclude or re-include paths from version tracking"` -> `"Exclude a path from version history (VCS-only: it stays in search), or remove the exclusion. Adding untracks the files the pattern matches, ending their history. Without confirm: true, more than 100 files return { confirmRequired: true, untracked } and change nothing: check the count with the user, then repeat with confirm: true. A timeout does not cancel the exclusion: check the outcome with watcher_check_vcs_exclusion before retrying."`
- parameter `glob`: `{"type":"string","description":"Glob pattern to exclude or re-include."}` -> `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"One gitignore pattern, absolute (under a VCS root) or relative to `root`. It is written root-anchored (`/` + the root-relative pattern) to the root's `.git/info/exclude`. Brackets are a character class: escape them to name a file literally (`Report \\[draft\\].docx`). A newline, a leading `!` or `#`, braces, or a pattern matching the whole root is refused."}`
- parameter `root`: `{"type":"string","description":"Tracked root to target (defaults to auto-detect)."}` -> `{"description":"VCS root to write under (default: the root containing the glob); a glob outside it is refused.","type":"string"}`
- parameter `remove`: `{"type":"boolean","description":"When true, remove the exclusion rule (re-include the path)."}` -> `{"description":"Remove the pattern instead of adding it (from `.git/info/exclude`, else from the `.gitignore` a 0.20.0 exclude wrote). Files are not re-added; their next change is versioned again.","type":"boolean"}`
- parameter `confirm` added: `{"description":"Required (true) when adding the pattern would untrack more than 100 files.","type":"boolean"}`
- schema `additionalProperties`: `undefined` -> `false`
